kjv: he (Shechem) had wrought folly in Israel
mine: he (Shechem) had done an outrage in Israel
note: nevalah means a vile, sacrilegious act, especially sexual (cf. 2 Sam 13:12). "Folly" now sounds like mere foolishness.
betach ("in security") can describe the attackers (boldly) or the city (off guard). Since the townsmen were in pain, the city's defencelessness fits better.
